changelog: **Core Web Vitals (#1593):** a sampled `<WebVitalsReporter>` (Next's `useReportWebVitals`) beacons LCP/CLS/INP/FCP/TTFB with a route template only (`src/lib/webVitalsRule.ts`) to the anonymous, rate-limited `POST /api/telemetry/vitals`, which writes one `web_vital` log line; off unless the build sets `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_VITALS_SAMPLE_RATE`. A CI budget, `e2e/web-vitals-budget.spec.ts` (`@smoke`), holds `/` and `/portal` to the first-load JavaScript, CLS and LCP ceilings in `e2e/web-vitals-budget.json`.
